delivered: Design contract V2_CRON_MODEL_TOOL.md (doc-only, NO source/test/migration change): model-facing cronjob_manage as a thin adapter over SchedulingService (no second kernel)

Tool surface decision: adopt create/list/update/pause/resume/remove + schedule/name/prompt/timezone/skills(skill_id<=8)/context_from(<=4)/continuity; reject run (needs manual-fire ledger), deliver/failure_deliver (autonomous outbound), model/provider/base_url/pinned (owner spend decision), script/monitor/no_agent (arbitrary code/fetch surface), enabled_toolsets/workdir/attach_to_session, repeat (needs occurrence-count retirement)

Schedule grammar decision: exactly four decidable forms (numeric 5-field cron; interval 30m/90s/2h/1d/every N units -> 60..31536000; relative once 'in N' -> kind=once start_at=server clock+delta, never model-computed absolute time; offset-bearing ISO -> once); natural-language day/time rejected with invalid_schedule

Skill binding decision: new schedule_skills table (schedule_id,revision,position 1..8,skill_id,revision_id) validated existing+enabled+platform at save; fire passes skill_ids/skill_platform to accept_turn -> skill_capture_run(selected) -> notice injection; archived skill does not block the run; binding is guidance text only and grants no permission

Output dependency decision: new schedule_context_refs table (position 1..4) + schedule_revisions.continuity column (no 'self' literal); save validates same agent/exists/not archived/not self/<=4/acyclic (DFS <=64 nodes, <=4 hops); fire injects redacted 2000-char excerpts of the referenced schedule's latest SUCCEEDED occurrence assistant message (failed/cancelled/unknown/blocked skipped; no-output and archived annotated, never blocking), total <=8000 chars, appended as a fixed prefix to accept_turn text; no output files added

Persistence decision v0049: ALTER schedule_revisions ADD continuity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 + CHECK; two new tables with scoped FKs/unique(schedule_id,revision,position)/position CHECK/identity+keep triggers; downgrade raises; table count 143->145 with three existing pins updated; ScheduleValue extended and shared by owner HTTP + model tool to avoid two drifted definitions

Authorization/budget decision: writes=True reuses engine write-tool approval gate (resource=schedules); owner approves the schedule definition, not every fired action (in-job writes still gate, delivery still owner-approved outbox); spend uses existing reserve_call daily budget, no new quota

Action semantics: create non-idempotent + unknown never replayed + list reconciliation; update patch semantics with revision CAS (revision_conflict) and max(now,last_scheduled_at) next_at recompute (no catch-up burst); pause/resume = save(enabled); remove = archive (pending occurrence -> cancelled/schedule_archived)
Implementation steps (four independent batches: persistence / trigger chain / model tool / end-to-end) and bounds+safety listed
